q01: Reserve boundaries are not measured as polygons; the 12.6% wash share is a crude colour threshold with false positives.

q02: Clipped labels cannot be read and are not guessed: plate two 'rve' (top-left) and KORBEL's extent; plate three 'K', 'Northwood C...' and the left-edge 'Seaview'.

q02: Colours and font faces of the plate pins and labels were not sampled; only classes, positions and counts were read.
q02: The repo holds nothing further on how plates two and three were captured (zoom level, provider).

q03: The Azlen clip itself (a 13-second video) is not in the repo or the brief, so nothing of the original could be measured; all seven properties come from one paragraph and two reply lines.
q03: Fog source is undecided (W.weather has no fog state), so P4's determinism test cannot run yet; fog magnitude and whether fog masks names are open.

q03: The Mamban outline stroke and the coast cream rim were seen on crops but not measured numerically.
q03: Capture protocol is undefined: P7 needs a stated sheet capture (Leaflet controls and panels hidden or not) before 'no chrome' is testable.
q03: Direction of pooling (darker, more saturated, or both) is not given by the brief.
q03: Relief proxies hold only inside the EPESHU_HF window (R22); raw DEM contours at about 84 screen px per cell at z10.34 need a smoothing rule nobody has specified.
q03: Autocorrelation used five 256x256 patches of one chart with hand-thresholded colour classes, so coverage fractions are floors and Lc figures are medium confidence.

q10: Whether the two Lamor reaches are one river: the line breaks for 36.5 atlas px under the L of LEPONIA (1267,1503 to 1291,1531); likely one river under the letter but the print does not prove it, so the rule needs a ruling on bridging under lettering.
q10: Where the Medem north branch goes after 1544,1663: it ends at the N glyph of LEPONIA exactly on sheet one's south edge (y 1664), so whether it enters the M band is not established.
q10: Whether the Kardunash north branch (P4_N, light line, 82% of samples within 1.5 px of ink) is complete: the trace stops under the I of LEPONIA at about 1675,1724.

q10: Mouths: the automatic mask excludes 4.5 atlas px around the coast, so every mouth (and the P3 tail to Dramuz, ~21 px from the anchor) was placed by hand at roughly 5-8 px accuracy; a Job 3 unit should snap them to the shoreline polyline.
q10: Print flow direction is not drawn: head-to-mouth orientation of each reach is inferred from the coast end and the DEM, not from the print.
q10: Rivers outside the DEM window were not surveyed (R22: no DEM, so no rivers.json there); whether other sheets need river geometry is a Job 2 question.
q10: Only #s=epeshu was dumped; procedural seeds' rivers were not examined.

q10: A cold reader cannot re-run the numbers from the repo: trace, mask and D8 scripts lived in a temp directory (repo scripts forbidden); the refs give method and thresholds. Promoting the trace to tools/ is a Job 2 or 3 decision.
q10: The sim run showed one ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID resource load (an external resource blocked by this sandbox's proxy); no page errors, but the URL was not traced.
